      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a silent failure bug where invalidateblock returns success despite failure to disconnect or invalidate a block. As noted in issue #36546, callers are told the operation succeeded even when corrupted undo data leaves the chain partially rolled back."
    },

      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies Chainstate::InvalidateBlock() in src/validation.cpp to record failure details in BlockValidationState.",

      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Improves error propagation during block disconnection and genesis block handling without altering consensus rules or chainstate logic. It ensures block invalidation failures correctly populate the validation state rather than being silently dropped."
